verdict.rationale: uv is itself a comprehensive official CLI (uv init/add/remove/run/lock/tool/pip/python etc.) with a full reference documented at docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/cli/, plus autocompletion, self-update, and CI integration action — richly documented first-party and corroborated by extensive hands-on community usage. Missing for 10: no independent structured API/schema (openapi probes 404) though this is not typically required for a CLI tool.
